assertions.why: the skill file itself must exist for forge-skill-testing to be usable at all
wp-disclosure-ab: this skill must obey the same wp3b description-length budget it documents for every other skill
the skill must instruct reading its own learnings.md before use and appending corrections after (same substrate as forge-code-review/forge-intake)
the activation-test protocol (trigger vs near-miss phrases, >=95% target) is the core deliverable and must stay documented
the fresh-session A/B benchmark protocol must stay documented and clearly separated from the cheaper activation test
the A/B benchmark must stay explicitly opt-in (costs real runs) — never a merge/ship gate, per the work package
activation-test results must be logged in the project's real skill registry, not a throwaway note nobody reads
this protocol must stay explicitly positioned as step 2 after forge-skill-evals.cjs's binary evals, not a replacement for them
the copy/paste worksheet (tier-3 reference material) must exist alongside the protocol doc
this skill must obey the same 500-line body guidance the new skill_hygiene doctor check enforces project-wide
